notes: Primary source is Extron's official specifications PDF (media.extron.com/public/download/files/specs/XPA_2002_D4_121611.pdf), extracted directly and cross-checked against the XPA 2002 user/setup manuals (manualslib.com mirrors). All audio and control I/O connectors on this unit are captive/pluggable screw-terminal blocks (modeled here as "euroblock" — the closest match in the allowed connector list; no XLR, RCA, or TRS jacks are present). The two audio inputs are separate 3-pole 3.5 mm terminal blocks (one per channel), not a single stereo jack. No grade applies to any port — these are all baseband analog audio, contact-closure control, and AC power, none of which are bandwidth-graded connector types. AC inlet is confirmed as IEC (C13/C14, standard "IEC power cord") via accessory/manual references; the spec sheet itself states only the electrical rating (100-240 VAC, 1.5 A) without naming the physical inlet type, so this connector choice is inferred from included-accessories documentation rather than stated explicitly in the spec sheet. This is the base XPA 2002 (8/4-ohm low-impedance model); do not confuse with the XPA 2002-70V / XPA 2002-100V constant-voltage variants or the newer XPA U 2002 SB (Ultra series), which have different rear-panel layouts.

ports.name: Audio Input 1
ports.note: 3.5 mm captive screw connector, 3-pole; balanced or unbalanced stereo/mono audio input

ports.name: Audio Input 2
ports.note: 3.5 mm captive screw connector, 3-pole; balanced or unbalanced stereo/mono audio input

ports.name: Speaker Output
ports.note: 5 mm screw lock captive screw connector, 4-pole; 2 channels at 4 or 8 ohms, or 1 bridged mono at 8 ohms, 100-400 W rms depending on load/mode

ports.name: Control/Remote
ports.note: 3.5 mm captive screw connector, 2-pole; standby power control via contact closure (pin 1 = GND, pin 2 = standby)

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: 100-240 VAC, 50-60 Hz, 1.5 A; IEC power cord included
